verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents an in-product AI that lets users 'answer questions and complete tasks' inside the Billing UI, which is a first-party in-product AI surface over the user's data. The docs never explicitly describe proactive insights or suggestions drawn from that data. The AI catalog-drafting feature works from a pricing page or document, not from the user's billing data, so it does not count toward this story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-generated insights or recommendations from billing data, details of which data the in-UI AI analyzes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Use AI inside the Chargebee Billing UI to answer questions and complete tasks.
